task_title: Judge tier1 can never pass on this host: tests/gate.sh live mode aborts with exit 2 when DUCKBRAIN_URL is unset
task_criteria: judge/tier1 launch path supplies DUCKBRAIN_URL so a verdict recorded on this host has its tests step passed=true; fail-closed kept (unset DUCKBRAIN_URL still exits 2; AUGER_CI=1 downgrade on non-runner host still refuses); audit bound_failed_verdict drops below the 27 recorded at filing

items.criterion: judge/tier1 launch path supplies DUCKBRAIN_URL so a verdict recorded on this host has its tests step passed=true; fail-closed kept (unset DUCKBRAIN_URL still exits 2; AUGER_CI=1 downgrade on non-runner host still refuses); audit bound_failed_verdict drops below the 27 recorded at filing
items.detail: The criterion has three clauses; clauses 1 and 2 PASS, clause 3 FAILS as measured. (1) SUPPLY + GREEN VERDICT: .gitreins/config.yaml:22 (commit 4638a30, the only file it touches) now reads `test_command: DUCKBRAIN_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 bash tests/gate.sh`; this shell env assignment demonstrably reaches the gate — the installed gitreins engine executes this string verbatim (pipx venv engine/guard_manager.py:3433 reads guards.test_command, spawned via command_hygiene.run_bounded shell=True at command_hygiene.py:189/200 through guard_manager.py:3492-3500), and .gitreins/history/2026-11-25/cc32ff40/verdict.json (run on this host, worktree /home/kara/auger, evaluated_at 2026-11-25T01:51:40) records the tier1 tests step passed=true exit=0 ending 'LIVE ARMS: ran 2; skipped 0 / GATE PASS'; first-hand probe `DUCKBRAIN_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 GATE_MODE_ONLY=1 bash tests/gate.sh` -> 'gate mode: live' rc=0, and a 45s probe with the URL set passed the preflight into the pytest arm; ambient DUCKBRAIN_URL in this shell is empty, so the URL comes solely from that config line. (2) FAIL-CLOSED KEPT, first-hand: `env -u DUCKBRAIN_URL bash tests/gate.sh` -> rc=2 'ERROR: DuckBrain URL missing — set DUCKBRAIN_URL before running the live gate' (tests/gate.sh:78-80, exit 2 at :94); `AUGER_CI=1 GITHUB_ACTIONS= CI= bash tests/gate.sh` on this non-runner host -> rc=2 'ERROR: refusing AUGER_CI=1 downgrade on a non-runner host' (tests/gate.sh:29-35); git show 4638a30 --name-only = .gitreins/config.yaml only, so tests/gate.sh is untouched. (3) AUDIT DROP NOT ACHIEVED: first-hand `python3 scripts/audit_board_evidence.py` prints `bound_failed_verdict=28 ... RESULT: OK` — 28 is NOT below the 27 recorded at filing. --verbose composition shows the increment is exactly the new row `BOUND AUG-208 cc32ff40 (fail)` alongside the 27 pre-existing BOUND(fail) rows (AUG-200, AUG-205 589dd5f9, AUG-206 8a7e18a2, AUG-207 36569fbe, ...): the prior judge verdict of AUG-208 itself, whose tier1 tests step was green but whose overall passed=false was caused by clause 3 measuring 27 at that time. Even in the best case (this evaluation recording COMPLETE and the row re-binding to a passing run) the count returns to 27, not below it; a drop below 27 requires green re-recorded verdicts for the other bound rows, and the change touches only .gitreins/config.yaml — the commit message itself concedes 'bound_failed_verdict=27 (unchanged, as expected — the drop accumulates as post-fix verdicts re-record)'. The criterion as written demands the measured drop; it has not happened.

items.criterion: The judge/tier-1 tests step executes guards.test_command verbatim through the installed engine, so the env prefix `DUCKBRAIN_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000` actually reaches tests/gate.sh (wired, not dead config)
items.detail: Installed engine: /home/kara/.local/share/pipx/venvs/gitreins/lib/python3.14/site-packages/engine/guard_manager.py:3433 `test_command = self.config.get("guards", {}).get("test_command", ...)`; :3492-3500 spawns `spawn_cmd = scanner_nice.shell_wrap(resolved_cmd, ...)` then `command_hygiene.run_bounded(...)`; engine/command_hygiene.py:189/200 documents shell=True execution; _resolve_test_command (guard_manager.py:838+) passes commands without uv/pipenv/poetry runner prefixes through unchanged, so the leading env assignment survives. Empirical seam proof: cc32ff40 verdict tier1 tests step passed=True exit=0 with 'LIVE ARMS: ran 2; skipped 0 / GATE PASS' while the same shell has empty ambient DUCKBRAIN_URL (first-hand echo), and unset-URL runs exit 2 — the only URL source is the config line.

items.criterion: The change does not degrade the GitHub Actions CI arm: ci.yml runs tests/gate.sh directly and the hosted-CI skip path (AUGER_CI=1 + runner markers) remains the only CI route, unaffected by the guards.test_command edit
items.detail: .github/workflows/ci.yml:3,37-39 runs `tests/gate.sh` directly with AUGER_CI=1 in the job env and GitHub's runner markers — it does not consume guards.test_command; commit 4638a30 touched only .gitreins/config.yaml (git show --name-only); the non-runner refusal was re-verified first-hand rc=2, so a leaked AUGER_CI=1 off CI still fails closed.
